items.heading: Conch Salad
details: Key ingredients: conch, lime juice, onion, bell pepper, tomato
Dice fresh conch meat into small pieces.
Toss the conch with diced onion, pepper and tomato.
Dress generously with fresh lime and orange juice.
Chill briefly and serve cold as a tangy appetizer.

items.heading: Peas and Rice
details: Key ingredients: pigeon peas, rice, salt pork, tomato paste, thyme
Render salt pork with onion and tomato paste.
Add pigeon peas and thyme, simmering briefly to blend flavors.
Stir in rice and water, bringing to a boil.
Cover and cook on low until the rice is tender and fluffy.
